sections.heading: Dripping Course Content Only on Weekdays

steps.raw_text: Open your course and click the **Drip** tab.
Create a new drip campaign using the **Evergreen Repeating** template.
Enter a **Campaign Name** and click **Continue**.
Set the **Start Event** to your preferred trigger (e.g., product purchase or enrollment).
steps.context: your preferred trigger (e.g., product purchase or enrollment)

steps.raw_text: Configure the unlock schedule so that content unlocks every 1 day, but only on weekdays. You can achieve this by setting up multiple campaigns on the same course—one campaign for each weekday—or by using the **Day of the Week or Month** template and selecting Monday through Friday as your unlock days.

steps.raw_text: Click **Save** to apply the campaign.

sections.heading: Starting a Course on the First Monday of the Month

steps.raw_text: Open your course and click the **Drip** tab.
Click **Create first Drip Campaign** and select the **Day of the Week or Month** template.

steps.raw_text: Click **Continue** and enter a **Campaign Name**.
Under the scheduling options, select **First Monday** as the recurring day pattern. This tells Thrive Apprentice to unlock the first lesson on the first Monday of the month.

steps.raw_text: Go to the **Products** section in the left sidebar.
Create a separate product for each pacing option (e.g., "Standard Access" and "Accelerated Access").
When configuring each product's access settings, assign the appropriate drip campaign to each product.
Click **Save** on each product.

sections.heading: Excluding Lessons from a Drip Campaign

steps.raw_text: Open your drip campaign from the **Drip** tab.
Look for the option to exclude the first set of lessons from the drip schedule.
Specify how many initial lessons should be immediately accessible (e.g., the first 2 lessons).
Click **Save**. Those lessons will be available as soon as a student enrolls, while the remaining lessons follow the drip timeline.

sections.heading: Excluding Lessons from a Drip Campaign

steps.raw_text: Create a drip campaign using the **Start From Scratch** template.
Select the **Unlock content at custom intervals** option.
For each lesson you want to make immediately available, set the unlock delay to **0 days** or remove the unlock condition entirely.
steps.context: or remove the unlock condition entirely

steps.raw_text: Configure drip intervals for the remaining lessons as needed.
Click **Save** to apply the campaign.

sections.heading: Hiding Locked Lessons from the Lesson List

steps.raw_text: Navigate to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice**.
Open the course where you want to hide locked lessons.
Go to the course's design settings or the **Lesson List** element configuration.
Locate the option to control locked lesson visibility.
Enable the setting to **hide locked lessons** from the lesson list.
Click **Save** to apply the change.

sections.heading: Unlocking Content at Different Time Intervals

steps.raw_text: Open your course and click the **Drip** tab.
Create a drip campaign using any template (the **Start From Scratch** template gives you the most flexibility).
steps.context: template gives you the most flexibility)

steps.raw_text: Once the campaign is created, click on an individual lesson in the drip timeline to open its **Unlock Conditions**.
Set a custom time delay for that lesson (e.g., unlock 2 weeks after the previous lesson is completed instead of the default 1 week).
Repeat for each lesson that needs a unique interval.
Click **Save** to apply the changes.
